title: Mertens-only eventual positivity of the complete actual K3 higher-prime-power sector
summary: Current unconditional Mertens supplies the leading positive L^5 sector and an explicit threshold. Quantitative PNT is unnecessary for this weaker conclusion; it remains used by the separately frozen sharper L^2 plus bounded-remainder expansion.

sections.title: Exact old proved input and ordinary-prime remainder
sections.proof: Mertens.sum_mangoldt_div_eq_log (FromPNTPlus/Mertens.lean195), with the separate lower and upper theorems at155/173, proves for every x>=1 that -2<=sum_(n<=x)Lambda(n)/n-log x<=log4+4. The file uses Euler-Maclaurin, the exact divisor identity, and Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self; there is no PNT or RH hypothesis. Put W(y)=sum_(p<=exp y)log p/p for y>=0. The removed proper-power mass is nonnegative and <=sum_p log p/[p(p-1)]<=sum_(n>=2)log n/[n(n-1)]<=4. For the last bound use log n<=sqrt n for n>=1, n/(n-1)<=2 for n>=2 and sum_(n>=2)n^(-3/2)<=integral_1^infinity x^(-3/2)dx=2. Therefore -6<=W(y)-y<6 for all y>=0. In particular |W-y|<=6, including y=0 and every prime seam. Unique prime-power weights remain log p, never r log p.

sections.title: Literal K3 source and paid total variation
sections.proof: Use exactly the frozen raw native vectors u_e,u_o, beta=L^2/(16pi^2), Ne=924beta^2+1512beta+1764, No=84beta^2+392beta+724, a=No/Ne, D_L(theta)=E_o(L,theta)-a E_e(L,theta), and k_L(t)=D_L(1-t/L). No vector is unit-renormalized. The previously reviewed exact source identities give k(0)=k(L)=0 and integral_0^L k=-400a beta^2 L. Direct SourceMatrix differentiation on centered n,m in{-3,...,3} gives |partial_theta S_nm|<=24pi on[0,1]; Cauchy gives sum|u_n|<=sqrt7 ||u||, hence |E_p'|<=168pi Np. Because a Ne=No, integral_0^L|k'(t)|dt<=336pi No for every L>0. This is a bound for the whole source, including off-diagonal entries, and does not use a contact/eigenray/stationarity premise.

sections.title: Complete square channel from finite Abel summation
sections.proof: For B2(L)=-sum_(p<=exp(L/2))log p/p*k_L(2log p), finite Stieltjes integration gives B2=200a beta^2 L+2 integral_0^(L/2)(W(y)-y)k'(2y)dy. Both endpoint products vanish, including a prime at exp(L/2); the lower prime-free interval is retained. Thus |B2-200a beta^2 L|<=6 integral_0^L|k'|<=2016pi No. This formula uses W-y itself, not a convergent Mertens constant or any integrable decay of its remainder.

sections.title: Complete r>=3 sector, without PNT
sections.proof: The frozen H2 global native jet has C*=2^34, d0=175/(88pi^2), and |k_L(t)+d0 L^2 t^2|<=C*(t^2+t^4) for L>=1 and EVERY0<=t<=L. Define Tj=sum_(p prime,r>=3)log p*p^(-r/2)*(rlog p)^j for j=2,4. These are genuine positive finite constants. Splitting the active t=rlog p<=L terms and paying the omitted tail by L^2t^2<=t^4 gives |B_{>=3}-d0T2L^2|<=E, E=C*(T2+T4)+d0T4. This step uses only absolute convergence and the global jet. It does not consume the PNT-dependent square remainder H3/H4 from the sharper note.

sections.title: Explicit all-late threshold
sections.proof: Since No-Ne/11=(2800beta+6200)/11>0, 200a beta^2 L>=b L^5 where b=25/(352pi^4). For L>=1, beta<=L^2 implies No<=1200L^4. Set A=2419200pi. M3-M4 yield the unconditional complete bound B_{>=2}(L)>=bL^5-A L^4+d0T2L^2-E>=bL^5-A L^4-E. Consequently for every L>=L*=max(1,4A/b,(4E/b)^(1/5)), B_{>=2}(L)>=(b/2)L^5>0. All constants are chosen before L, with actual finite floor cutoff preserved. Also B_{>=2}/L^5 tends to b using a->1/11 and the same estimates. This is the previous leading asymptotic with weaker prerequisites and a newly explicit coarse threshold, not a stronger full-source sign.

sections.title: Optional wholly elementary numerical upper allowance for the moments
sections.proof: No unproved finiteness is hidden in L*. One may replace Tj by Uj=3^j*j!*4^(j+2)*[4(j+1)]^(j+1), j=2,4. Indeed writing r=k+3, p^(-k/2)<=(3/4)^k, (k+3)^j<=3^j(k+1)^j<=3^j*j!*binom(k+j,j), and the geometric generating sum is4^(j+1). Further (log n)^(j+1)<=[4(j+1)]^(j+1)n^(1/4), and sum_(n>=2)n^(-5/4)<=4. Thus Tj<=Uj. Set Ebar=2^34(U2+U4)+d0U4 and replace E by Ebar in L*. This is a very coarse explicit real constant; no numerical fitting, prime computation or PNT is required.

sections.title: Exact new use and remaining scope
sections.proof: The all-L actual canonical Arch gap is already locally externally Lean-proved with only L>0. Combining it with M5 makes the full Arch plus higher-power sector positive of order L^5 eventually. The remaining B1=-sum_(p<=exp L)log p/sqrt p*k_L(log p) is signed and unchanged. The current Mertens bound does not provide the needed lower comparison for B1; weighting W by exp(t/2) incurs the growing endpoint scale. Existing canonical older-prime budgets additionally require a generated stationary contact, and their source test t^2 e_Dz differs from k_L. K3 first integer birth and one-dimensional parity do not provide aperture stationarity. Hence neither those contact budgets nor the K3 source-moment equality supplies a missing sign here. No RH or Step4 closure, same-aperture negative pair or ground-stationarity conclusion is made.

sections.title: Reuse of the prior signed-rate theorem: forced ordinary-prime compensation
sections.proof: Let H(L)=A_Gamma(L)+B_{>=2}(L). The already proved actual Arch positivity and its separately derived A_Gamma=O(L^2), together with M5, give H~bL^5>0. Since G=H+B1, the prior actual K3 signed-rate theorem implies unconditionally, by its RH/off-zero case split: for every fixed kappa<1 and every R there exists L>=R with B1(L)<-kappa H(L). Under RH, G=O(L^(-7)) and hence B1/H->-1. Under an actual off-line zero, the negative excursions of G exceed any fixed polynomial and imply liminf B1/H=-infinity. This is a new specialization/reuse of that prior theorem, not a new independent arithmetic bound. No assertion at kappa=1, all-late comparison, or simultaneous parity negativity is made. A proposed eventual strict fractional lower comparison B1>=-kappa H with kappa<1 is therefore false; the boundary comparison remains unpaid.
